note_on_the_clip_hash: the clip's sha256 in the package (`b83e2c5a...`) is not the value `build_chrom_jab.py`'s own self-test prints (`3e50c8a4...`) because `complete_visibility()` post-processes every body clip during the build, taking the visibility group from 94 nodes to 98. That is the same treatment the Cloud fair clip gets; the transform half - 80 nodes over 42 frames, including Sword1, Sword2 and HaveR - is identical either way and was read back off the card to prove it.
single_variable: Two visible changes, whose failure modes are separable. The jab animation fills a move that was a one-frame pose; the Falchion exists only while the jab is out, so a crash, an invisible sword or a sword that will not leave all point at the sword alone.
